reason_for_new_unit: Historical prediction vectors and saved model weights required for RU-AML-01 evaluation-only recomputation were unavailable in repository storage. Under Section 40 and Section 20, a new preregistered full-rerun unit RU-AML-02 is required.
task: Transaction classification and multi-hop pattern detection (Cycle and Fan-In laundering typologies) on agent-based simulated financial network

dataset.name: IBM AMLSim Agent-Based Multi-Hop Transaction Graph

split.temporal_leakage_guard: Train transactions strictly have TIMESTAMP <= cutoff (140); Test transactions strictly have TIMESTAMP > cutoff (140); Zero future lookahead.
split.graph_leakage_guard: Account graph adjacency (adj_fwd, adj_bwd) and node features are constructed strictly from train transactions (train_indices); Test transaction edges never leak into training message passing.

model_family.tabular_baseline: Tabular MLP 0-Hop Baseline (no graph / no message passing)

hyperparameters.batch_sampling: Positive train edges + 10x balanced negative train edges per batch
hyperparameters.threshold_selection: Top 1% operational triage threshold (99th percentile of prediction scores on test split)
